source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Encouraging immediate ambulation right after the procedure, with fairly little attention paid to how the client is actually positioned afterward","B":"Encouraging immediate discharge from the facility without observing the client for any period of time following the biopsy","C":"Fairly little specific monitoring actually being needed once this particular biopsy procedure has been fully completed","D":"Monitoring vital signs closely for signs of bleeding, and positioning the client on the right side per protocol to help apply pressure to the biopsy site"}}
source_row.rationale: Post-liver biopsy care includes close vital sign monitoring for signs of bleeding (a significant risk given the liver's vascularity), and positioning the client on the right side per protocol to help apply pressure to the biopsy site, along with an appropriate observation period before discharge.
